name.value: Europe Old Fashion Bakery and Deli

description.value: Europe Bakery & Deli is a Port Coquitlam bakery producing fresh bread, donuts, and an extensive range of European-style pastries entirely in-house daily. The deli component rounds out the offering beyond pure baked goods. It serves both walk-in customers and online delivery orders via Uber Eats and SkipTheDishes.
